title: Contribute missing generic pieces to bricks
goal: Generic pieces bricks lacked are bricks PRs FPVBuddy uses
acceptance: Each missing generic piece (bottom navigation bar if tabs did not fit, any other from F-008-T01) is a merged PR in voidbrain/bricks under its own rules, named here by number, and FPVBuddy uses the release with it
privacy: Neutral content only; no secrets, tokens or personal data in Git.
escalation: A material scope or effort increase goes to the owner
A bricks component that cannot take FPVBuddy's look through the theme goes to bricks as a proposal, never a local override

effort.basis: Re-estimated 2026-11-25 after the owner decision (F-008-T07): the comparison with NERV's battery tab is dropped, since the views stay FPVBuddy's own; one or two small bricks components with review and release waits remain. Not a measurement.
